name: Donor Portal

hero.title: Your Donations. Your Control.
hero.body: Give donors a simple and convenient way to access their donation information and manage their contributions independently. The Donorfit Donor Portal puts donors in control of their giving experience.
hero.shotAlt: Donorfit Donor Portal sign-in page titled Donation Tracking, with an email field, a Send verification code button and the labels Privacy Protected and Secure Query
hero.shotCaption: The sign-in page of the Donor Portal.

what.title: What is the Donor Portal?
what.body1: The Donor Portal is a secure, personal area where your supporters can see what they have given to your organisation, download their receipts and certificates and manage their recurring donations, without having to contact your team.
what.body2: Donors sign in with their email address and a one-time verification code, so there is no password to remember. If an email address is linked to more than one organisation, the donor chooses which one to view.
facts: Sign in with email and a 6-digit code
Receipts and annual certificates to download
Recurring donations donors can adjust themselves

featuresTitle: What donors can do in the portal
featuresSub: Everything shown here is part of the Donor Portal today.

features.title: A personal overview
features.body: After signing in, donors see a welcome page with their total contributions, the date of their next recurring payment and a feed of their recent donations.
points: Date of the next recurring payment
Recent donations with status, payment method and amount
Filters by cause, duration, payment method and date

features.title: Donation history and receipts
features.body: A complete list of every donation, with its transaction code, cause, payment method, amount, date and status. Donors can download a receipt for each donation.
points: Search the list with the same filters as the overview
Gift Aid status, where your organisation uses it

features.title: Recurring donation management
features.body: Donors see their active recurring donations with the amount, cause, payment method and next renewal date, and can change them without contacting you.
points: Move the next donation date within the allowed range
View the recurring history or cancel

features.title: Profile and donation certificates
features.body: Donors keep their personal details and address up to date. Annual donation certificates are listed by year, with a preview and a download.
points: Update name, phone number and address
Annual donation certificates listed by year
Preview a certificate before it becomes available
The first download is the original; later downloads are marked "Duplikat"

more.title: Secure sign-in
more.text: Donors sign in with their email address and a 6-digit verification code. No password needed.

more.title: More than one organisation
more.text: If a donor's email is linked to several organisations, they choose which one to view.

more.title: Several languages
more.text: Donors can switch the portal language, including English and German.

more.title: Your logo
more.text: Your organisation's logo appears in the portal, and the portal can be served under your own domain.

more.title: A link in every email
more.text: You can add a self-service link to the Donor Portal to the emails Donorfit sends to your donors.

more.title: Certificate delivery
more.text: Choose whether annual certificates are available in the portal only, or sent by email and available in the portal.

stepsSub: Four steps from signing in to staying informed.

steps.title: Access your account
steps.description: Donors open your portal link, enter their email address and confirm with the 6-digit code sent to them.

steps.title: View your donations
steps.description: The overview and the donation list show every gift, its status and its receipt.

steps.title: Manage your contributions
steps.description: Donors adjust or cancel their recurring donations and keep their personal details up to date.

steps.title: Stay informed
steps.description: Receipts and annual donation certificates are ready to download, and your emails can link straight back to the portal.

donors.title: Convenient access
donors.text: Donation information is available whenever donors need it, without an email or a phone call.

donors.title: A clear history
donors.text: Every donation is listed with its cause, amount, date and status.

donors.title: Control over recurring gifts
donors.text: Donors change the amount, date or cause of a recurring donation, or cancel it, themselves.

donors.title: Easy account updates
donors.text: Personal details and address can be corrected in a few clicks.

donors.title: More transparency
donors.text: Receipts and annual certificates are always one download away.

orgs.title: A self-service experience
orgs.text: Offer donors a professional portal with your logo instead of handling every request by hand.

orgs.title: Fewer repetitive requests
orgs.text: Requests for receipt copies, address changes and amount changes no longer go through your team.

orgs.title: Better donor engagement
orgs.text: Donors who can see their history and impact stay connected to your work.

orgs.title: Stronger relationships
orgs.text: Giving donors control builds trust in how your organisation handles their support.

orgs.title: Organised donation management
orgs.text: Changes donors make in the portal update the same records your team works with.

faqs.question: How do donors sign in to the Donor Portal?
faqs.answer: Donors enter their email address on the portal sign-in page and receive a 6-digit verification code. After entering the code, they see their donations. There is no password to set up or remember.

faqs.question: Where do donors find the Donor Portal?
faqs.answer: Donors use your organisation's portal link. You can add this link to the emails Donorfit sends, and the portal can also be served under your own domain.

faqs.question: Can donors change or cancel recurring donations?
faqs.answer: Yes. Donors can change the amount, move the next donation date within the allowed range, choose a different cause, view the recurring history or cancel a recurring donation.

faqs.question: Can donors download receipts and donation certificates?
faqs.answer: Yes. Donors can download a receipt for each donation and their annual donation certificates. For annual certificates, the first download is the original and later downloads are marked "Duplikat".

faqs.question: What if a donor gives to more than one organisation?
faqs.answer: If the same email address is linked to several organisations using Donorfit, the donor chooses which organisation's donations to view after signing in.

faqs.question: Can donors update their personal details?
faqs.answer: Yes. Donors can update their name, phone number and address in their profile.

faqs.question: Is the Donor Portal included in Donorfit?
faqs.answer: A dedicated donor portal is part of the Donorfit platform. Recurring donations, and managing them in the portal, require the optional Recurring Subscription add-on.
